rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Article rough-draft rule; target is curriculum module file, not article.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Reference artefact rule; target is module file without reference sections.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Willison (line 12, prework section) and Cherny (line 72, pre-reads section) represent different functional placements, qualifying carve-out for deliberate reinforcement of fundamental concept.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise-closer rule; target is module file, not exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 66:All four sit in the gap before it. Do them and its moves land as things you've already seen. [followed immediately by four **Read:** items]. Restates count that structure already carries; vulnerable to staleness if items added/removed.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Delete "All four" from opening sentence; keep the forward assertion that these readings sit in the gap, or trim to "Optional. Do them and its moves land as things you've already seen."

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sweep-management rule; not applicable to single-file evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
Earn every technical term on first use.
Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
Memory vs context — use deliberately.
Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Structure-direction rule for exercises with prompts; target is module file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module — never repeat same Debrief.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise debrief rule; target is module file, not exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise instruction rule; target is module file with exercise links only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Self-study simulation rule; target module has no simulations.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes
Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
Inline links use target's title, never filename.
Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
Session / task / run split (all trainings).
No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise prompt rule; target is module file with exercise links only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chat-print aftermath rule; target is module file, not exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
Name the artifact, not the act.
Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
